content_of_post_to_answer: Why do I overthink so much, and why did it get worse all of the sudden?
answer: A sudden increase in overthinking is often less about having more thoughts and more about your mind trying to regain certainty after something changed: stress, uncertainty, a loss of control, or a new responsibility. The trap is treating every thought as a problem to solve instead of recognizing some thoughts are just signals of discomfort. I’ve explored this pattern in more detail on my profile if you want to go deeper. Overthinking grows when we confuse thinking harder with gaining clarity.
